text:
alex: FYI — finished incident wrap for the customer token-misroute pager. No active impact now, but we should schedule a short postmortem and update the on-call commander steps.

ops-bot: Incident opened: token-misroute-2187654321 — Severity: P2. Initial page -> 2024-11-03T02:12Z.

mira: thanks. can we confirm which customers saw degraded latency vs dropped requests? I saw a spike in 5xxs for the router service.

alex: quick summary: frontend routing node misread a feature flag, routed requests to a legacy cluster that doesn't have prefix-caching. That caused KV misses -> higher tail latencies and some timeouts. A small number of inference requests hit max retries and returned 502. Affected customers: 3 paid tenants, 9 trial orgs.

devon: ok. timeline + severity look right. did we capture traces for a representative trace id? can pair that to the alert groups.

alex: yes — saved traces and a short script to reproduce the misroute locally. trace id samples in the notes channel.

samir: for the postmortem, I can own the customer-impact section and the remediation ticket. Available to run the PM sync.

pm-jen: I can do the stakeholder comms template and send the briefing to the affected customers once we have the root cause + ETA for remediation.

leo: quick checklist proposal for runbook update:
1) Add explicit step to validate feature-flag->route mapping after deploy.
2) Add a guard in router: if cluster variant lacks prefix-cache, fall back to verified cluster or fail open with telemetry.
3) Add dashboard alert for routing-to-legacy-cluster count > 5 in 5m.

mira: ^ all good. also, add an on-call action: when a routing-related 5xx spike happens, check `router.cluster` tag distribution in traces and run the `dump-routing-table` command.

alex: putting together a short runbook diff. paste below — feel free to suggest edits.

alex: ```
# On-call commander: routing fallback checks
- If >10% requests in 5m route to clusters without KV prefix-cache:
    - run `routing check --quick`
    - verify `routing.table` entries for experimental flags
    - if mismatch, set rollout: `ff toggle <flag> off` for that zone and notify infra
- Escalation: page infra oncall after 15m or if >=5 customers affected
```

devon: I suggest lowering the threshold in the first bullet to 5% for the beta rollout zones. We saw impact at lower numbers.

samir: agreed. also add a line to record the last known good routing commit hash in the incident ticket — helps rollbacks.

alex: noted. I'll update the diff.

ops-bot: Reminder: runbook-edit request created #RB-4227 assigned to alex. Due date: 2024-11-07.

mira: scheduling: can we do a 30-min postmortem tomorrow 09:00 PT? aim: timeline, customer impact, and action owners.

pm-jen: 09:00 PT works for me. I'll draft the customer note after the meeting.

leo: I'll prepare a tiny dashboard patch and link to the PR in the postmortem doc.

devon: question on mitigation: should we add an automated integration test to the deploy pipeline that rejects any routing change that maps a flag to a cluster lacking prefix-cache?

alex: yes, that's a separate ticket. I'll include it in remediation: create ticket to add deploy-time check + unit test for flag to cluster mapping.

samir: assigning remediation tickets now:
- RB-4227 (runbook edits) -> alex
- INF-7832 (router guard + alerting) -> leo
- QA-9011 (deploy-time mapping check) -> devon
- COMM-555 (customer comms) -> pm-jen

mira: thanks. can we also add a short note in the handoff template so future on-callers see if a routing flag was recently toggled? small field: `recent_flag_changes` with last 48h list.

alex: done — adding to the on-call handoff template and to the incident commander checklist.

ops-bot: Postmortem scheduled: 2024-11-04T16:00Z -> Calendar invite sent to participants: alex, mira, devon, samir, leo, pm-jen.

mira: perfect. action owners, please update your tickets with ETA before the postmortem. I'll consolidate and publish the final postmortem doc. :thumbsup:

alex: thanks all — appreciate the quick triage. closing thread and will share the draft before the meeting.

ops-bot: Incident closed by alex. Incident duration: 00:42:13.
